column1: # The fallback census's counts and sizes (docs/design/fallback-faces.md,
# "Every script, emoji, mathematics, music and symbols"): the rows
# prints over the candidates of the design's tables and FT-01's four region
# faces, each fetched from the upstream its storage row names, with its WOFF2
# Its four tables in its order, each row led by its table's name and each
# table headed by the row the census prints for it. A count or a size is the
# same in a release and a debug build. the_committed_census_is_whole, beside
# the census, holds this record whole and adding up, and
# the_designs_outcomes_are_the_records holds the design's outcomes to it.
#   value     each Script value, by its ISO 15924 code, and each class, and
#   coverage  a row for each face and each value or class its cmap covers any
#   storage   a row for each face: its bytes as published and as WOFF2,
#             whether the WOFF2 form unpacks through woff.rs to a face of the
#             published one's glyph count, its upstream and its SPDX
#   group     a row for each feature group: the faces it carries, every
#             candidate of it but, of the mathematics candidates, the one the
#             design's rule chooses; their bytes as published and as WOFF2
#             together, the second what a native build of the group carries
